title: Li's criterion computation (lambda_n >= 0 for all n)

power_sums.note: Q_m exact (Taylor of xi'/xi at s=0) vs P_m over first 200 zeros; difference is the exact tail contribution

tail_diagnostics.note: validates the density-integral tail estimate against the exact tail (n<=20)

asymptotic_fit.note: growth is ~ n log n (A within 4% of 1/2), but the linear constant has NOT converged by n=200: c(n) = 2*lambda_n/n - log n drifts across the expected limit 2*gamma-1-log(4*pi) with O(1/n) corrections. Honest result: the asymptotic form is confirmed, the constant needs n >> 200.

truncation_note: Plan assumed first 200 zeros suffice for n<=200 with error O(n^2/log K). Actual tail (exact, n<=20): 0.0021 at n=1, 0.8243 at n=20; density-integral estimate at n=200: 82.12 (lambda_200 ~ 306.8). Partial sums S_K(n) are termwise nonnegative on the critical line, hence rigorous lower bounds; tails are additive.
